problems.note: The required code is not_reported. Table 3 reports arm means and SDs plus a three-arm omnibus F test; Section 6.1 reports omnibus mixed-ANOVA effects and within-arm baseline-to-MCT tests. Neither reports sampling uncertainty for this ChatGPT-versus-Google contrast. The extraction specification defines se_basis as the paper's own uncertainty for this contrast and assigns not_reported when none is printed. Participant-level SDs describe score dispersion; the possibility of subsequently deriving an SE from SDs and counts does not make a contrast SE paper-reported. Keep unit and sd_level as participant.

summary: Checked all six estimates against the full 84,429-character markdown conversion and the cited PDF pages. All 24 recorded means/SDs and all nine non-null estimate-level participant counts agree with the PDF and belong to the stated outcomes and arms. Three ChatGPT-versus-Google records incorrectly code se_basis as participant despite the absence of paper-reported uncertainty for those contrasts; the required code is not_reported. The other requested outcome/design codes are supported. Null peer-arm analysis counts, observation units, and SD levels appropriately preserve the unresolved mapping from 110 peer-arm participants in 55 dyads to analyzed scores. No additional eligible outcome or contrast was found in the available article; baseline measures, self-reports, within-arm changes, covariate associations, omnibus tests, and non-AI contrasts are appropriately excluded. The markdown and 16-page PDF end with a notice of a separate online appendix, without its contents or an embedded attachment. No matching local supplement was found. Read-only urllib requests to the Wiley article and Crossref DOI API both failed with WinError 10013, so completeness beyond the supplied article remains unverified.
